example: The incident goes to show that even small errors can have serious consequences.
exampleZh: 這宗事件足以說明，即使是小錯誤也可能造成嚴重後果。

examples.en: The incident goes to show that even small errors can have serious consequences.
examples.zh: 這宗事件足以說明，即使是小錯誤也可能造成嚴重後果。
examples.highlight: The incident goes to show that even small errors can have serious consequences.

rules.zh: 核心表達是 go(es) to show that 以下才是固定核心：【go(es) to show that + clause】 其他詞語只屬於可選延伸：【just；only；clearly；further；once again；really；may；seems to】 例如：【The result goes to show that the method works.】 這項結果足以說明這個方法有效。 這項結果可能足以說明這個方法有效。 這項結果只能說明還需要進行更多測試。 詞語【may】和 only 都不是固定表達的一部分。它們只是改變句子的語氣或結論強度。
rules.en: go(es) to show that + clause just only clearly further once again really may seems to appears to if anything The result goes to show that the method works. The result may go to show that the method works. The result only goes to show that more testing is needed.

rules.zh: 通常是一項證據、事件、事實或例子例句 X：可以是普通名詞詞組：。這宗意外足以說明安全規則十分重要。 例句 X：可以是複數名詞：。這些結果足以說明新制度有效。 例句 X：可以是代詞：。這正好說明外表有時會使人產生誤解。 例句 X：可以是 what 子句：。所發生的事情足以說明溝通極為重要。 例句 X：也可以是 the fact that 子句：。所有人都提早到達這個事實，足以說明他們認真看待這次會議。
rules.en: X The accident goes to show that safety rules matter. These results go to show that the new system is effective. It just goes to show that appearances can be misleading. What happened goes to show that communication is essential. The fact that everyone arrived early goes to show that they took the meeting seriously.

rules.zh: 動詞要與主語配合單數主語使用：【goes to show；The mistake goes to show that everyone needs to check their work.】 複數主語使用：【go to show；The mistakes go to show that everyone needs to check their work.】 不可寫成：【The mistakes goes to show...】
rules.en: goes to show The mistake goes to show that everyone needs to check their work. go to show The mistakes go to show that everyone needs to check their work. The mistakes goes to show...

rules.zh: 後面必須接完整子句在【That】後面需要有主語和動詞。第二句在 that 後面只有名詞詞組，沒有完整的主語加動詞結構。
rules.en: That The incident goes to show that small problems can grow quickly. The incident goes to show that the importance of preparation.

rules.zh: 後面使用原形動詞 show 這裏的 to 是不定詞標記，因此後面使用原形動詞：【goes to show；go to show；may go to show；seems to go to show】 不可寫成：【goes to showing；goes to showed】
rules.en: To goes to show go to show may go to show seems to go to show goes to showing goes to showed

rules.zh: 可以加入副詞，但副詞不是固定句型的一部分常見位置是放在 goes 前面：【X just goes to show that...；X only goes to show that...；X further goes to show that...；X once again goes to show that...】 例如：【Her response just goes to show that confidence does not require a loud voice.】 她的回應正好說明，有自信並不代表必須提高聲量。 第二項結果進一步說明，這項變化並非偶然。
rules.en: X just goes to show that... X only goes to show that... X further goes to show that... X once again goes to show that... Her response just goes to show that confidence does not require a loud voice. The second result further goes to show that the change was not accidental.

rules.zh: 可以使用情態動詞或 seem、appear 這個模式可能顯示，較年輕的使用者偏好較短的影片。 這些證據看來足以說明問題十分普遍。 這些形式可以避免把結論說得過分肯定。
rules.en: Subject + may + go to show that... Subject + can + go to show that... Subject + seems to + go to show that... Subject + appears to + go to show that... The pattern may go to show that younger users prefer shorter videos. The evidence appears to go to show that the problem is widespread.

rules.zh: 可以使用否定形式沒有人投訴這個事實，未必足以說明所有人都感到滿意。 這些研究結果並不足以說明這種治療對每一名病人都有效。 目標表達【not necessarily】表示證據不足以支持一項肯定結論。
rules.en: Singular subject + does not go to show that... Plural subject + do not go to show that... The fact that nobody complained does not necessarily go to show that everyone was satisfied. The findings do not go to show that the treatment works for every patient. not necessarily

rules.zh: 可以使用疑問形式銷售額上升是否足以說明該廣告有效？ 這些例子是否足以說明該規則不公平？ 使用疑問句時，goes 要變回 go。
rules.en: Does + singular subject + go to show that...? Do + plural subject + go to show that...? Does the increase in sales go to show that the advertisement was effective? Do these examples go to show that the rule is unfair?

rules.zh: 目標句型可以出現在較長句子的不同位置它不一定要放在整句最前面。雖然改善幅度不大，但這足以說明該方法具有一定價值。 結果令人失望，但這足以說明事前準備並不能消除所有風險。 綜合來看，這些報告足以說明問題十分普遍。
rules.en: Although the improvement was small, it goes to show that the method has some value. The result was disappointing, but it goes to show that preparation cannot remove every risk. Taken together, these reports go to show that the problem is widespread.

rules.zh: 過去發生的事情仍可使用 goes to show 這宗意外在去年發生，但它足以說明這條道路仍然需要改善。 意外是在過去發生，但說話者現在正從意外中帶出一項結論，因此可使用現在式 goes。在某些語境中可以成立，但不是本練習的主要教學形式。
rules.en: The accident happened last year, but it goes to show that the road still needs improvement. went to show that

rules.zh: 與 shows that 的分別目標表達【X shows that...】是較中性、直接的說法。結果顯示新制度速度較快。 通常較有「由這件事可見」或「這件事帶出一個道理」的意味。這些結果足以說明，即使是小改變也能帶來影響。 特別適合：從具體例子帶出較廣泛的道理；對事件作出反思；強調某件事提供了一項有用證據；在說話、演說或評論中帶出結論。
rules.en: Goes to show that X shows that... The results show that the new system is faster. X goes to show that... The results go to show that even a small change can make a difference. goes to show that

rules.zh: 本句型不一定等於【proves that】；後者通常表示證據已足以確定某件事。目標表達【goes to show that】可以只是表示某項事件有助支持或說明一項結論。因此，在科學報告或嚴謹研究中，如果證據未能完全證明因果關係，便不應把 goes to show that 自動理解為「已完全證實」。
rules.en: Goes to show that does not necessarily mean proves that. Proves that normally indicates that the evidence establishes something conclusively, whereas goes to show that may simply mean that an event supports or illustrates a conclusion. The structure works with singular and plural subjects, with It, This or That, with What-clauses, and with The fact that-clauses. It may include adverbs such as just, only, further or once again, follow a modal verb, or appear after seems or appears. It can also be negated, questioned, introduced by an optional opening phrase, or joined to a main clause with but. In scientific or rigorous research, do not treat it as proof of causation when the evidence is incomplete.

benefits.zh: 幫助你從具體例子帶出一個道理你可以先提及一項事件、結果或行為，再說明它反映了甚麼較廣泛的事實。這宗事件足以說明清晰溝通極為重要。 這比只列出事件而沒有解釋其意義更加完整。
benefits.en: The incident goes to show that clear communication is essential.

benefits.zh: 把證據和結論連接起來這個句型能清楚告訴讀者：前面的 X 是證據或例子；在【that】後面的內容是由該證據帶出的結論。讀者不需要猜測兩項資料之間有甚麼關係。
benefits.en: The structure explicitly connects evidence with a conclusion: X supplies the evidence or example, and the that-clause states the conclusion drawn from it. The reader does not have to guess how the two ideas relate.

benefits.zh: 讓反思和評論更自然在討論事件後，你可以使用這個句型自然地帶出自己的觀察。一個小錯誤延誤了整個項目。這足以說明每個細節都十分重要。 這種寫法適合：個人經歷；新聞評論；演說；故事反思；作文結論。
benefits.en: A small mistake delayed the whole project. It goes to show that every detail matters.

benefits.zh: 避免不斷重複 This shows that 學生經常反覆使用：【This shows that...；This shows that...；This shows that...】 提供另一種自然表達方式，使句式更有變化。不過，兩者沒有任何一個在所有情況下都一定較好。正式學術報告通常仍會較常使用 shows、詞語【indicates】或 demonstrates。
benefits.en: This shows that... goes to show that

benefits.zh: 可以控制結論的強弱你可以加入不同詞語，表達不同程度的肯定。結果足以說明…… 結果可能說明…… 結果未必足以說明…… 這能幫助你避免把證據說得過分肯定。
benefits.en: The result goes to show that... The result may go to show that... The result does not necessarily go to show that...

benefits.zh: 讓句子有更多不同的開頭和組織方式你可以用不同形式開始句子：【What happened goes to show that...；The fact that he apologised goes to show that...；Taken together, the results go to show that...；If anything, the complaint goes to show that...】 這些變化能減少所有句子都以普通名詞主語開始的情況。
benefits.en: What happened goes to show that... The fact that he apologised goes to show that... Taken together, the results go to show that... If anything, the complaint goes to show that...
